item.title: Home Minister Amit Shah Inaugurates ₹227-Crore Redeveloped Batadrava Than in Assam's Nagaon
item.description: GUWAHATI: Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Monday, December 29 inaugurated the redeveloped Batadrava Than, officially known as the Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardeva Abhirbhav Kshetra, at Nagaon marking the completion of a major cultural and religious project undertaken by the Assam government at a cost of ₹227 crore. item.title: Supreme Court Stays Aravalli Mining Ruling Amid Protests, Calls for Expert Review
item.description: GUWAHATI: Supreme Court on Monday, December 29, stayed its ruling from last month on the definition of the Aravalli Hills, citing the need for clarifications, and directed the formation of a committee of experts to study the environmental impact of earlier recommendations, which were largely made by bureaucrats. item.title: One Dead After Fire Breaks Out in Two Coaches of Tatanagar–Ernakulam Express in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: GUWAHATI: One person died after two coaches of the Tatanagar–Ernakulam Express caught fire near Yalamanchili in Andhra Pradesh shortly after 12.45 am on Monday, December 29. Officials said there were 82 passengers in one of the affected coaches and 76 in the other when the blaze broke out. The victim’s body was later recovered from the B1 coach. item.title: Assam Tops India’s Fastest-Growing State Economies Over Five Years
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam has emerged as the fastest-growing major state economy in India over the last five years, recording a growth of 45% in Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP), according to data compiled from the Reserve Bank of India. ALSO READ: KV Maligaon Alumni Meet Draws Participation from India and Abroad The state’s GSDP rose from ₹2.4 lakh crore in FY20 to ₹3.5 lakh crore in FY25, placing it ahead of larger economies such as Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh in percentage growth terms.

item.title: KV Maligaon Alumni Meet Draws Participation from India and Abroad
item.description: Former students of Kendriya Vidyalaya Maligaon came together on Saturday, December 27 for the Pan KV Maligaon Alumni Meet, drawing participation from alumni based across India and abroad. The event served as a reunion for past batches and an opportunity to reconnect with teachers and the school community. item.title: Kaziranga Sees Rise in Foreign Tourists with Over 6.6 K Footfall Till December 27
item.description: GUWAHATI: Kaziranga National Park and Tiger Reserve has recorded a strong surge in tourist arrivals in the 2025–26 season, with a notable rise in foreign visitors. As per official data up to December 27, the park welcomed 1,46,157 tourists, including 6,699 foreign nationals. item.title: Koneru Humpy and Arjun Erigaisi Win Bronze at 2025 World Rapid Chess Championship
item.description: GUWAHATI: Indian chess players Koneru Humpy and Arjun Erigaisi won bronze medals at the 2025 FIDE World Rapid Chess Championships in Doha on Monday, December 29. Humpy finished third in the women’s section with 8.5 points, tied for first after the final round but placed third due to tie-break rules. Arjun, 22, claimed bronze in the Open category, becoming only the second Indian man, after Viswanathan Anand, to win a medal at the World Rapid Championships. item.title: Khaleda Zia, Bangladesh’s First Female Prime Minister, Dies at 80
item.description: GUWAHATI: Bangladesh’s former prime minister Khaleda Zia has died aged 80 after a prolonged illness in Dhaka, her party has confirmed. The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) said she died at 6am local time on Tuesday, December 30. Reports said Khaleda had been receiving treatment since November for lung infection symptoms, and doctors said she was also suffering from advanced liver cirrhosis, arthritis, diabetes, and heart and chest problems.
